add.title: mastermind.md says to log `search` lines; append.mjs refuses `search` as a verb
add.why: On 2026-11-06, mastermind-page-design's `{"search":{…}}` lines to task.jsonl were REFUSED as flat lines (no known verb). They were wrapped as `{"note":{"search":…}}` to pass. Either add search/checked/find/answer to the task.jsonl verbs, or have the skill say to wrap them in `note`.
